variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
